summary: Iteration 3 bug-fix testing PASSED end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_bugfix_iter3.py (11 tests, ALL PASS in 2.4s) covering — (a) Product validation: POST /api/products with empty name → 400 'Product name is required'; empty customer_id → 400; valid create returns status 'active' plus serial_number/tag_number/reference_no fields. (b) Product edit: PUT /api/products/{id} mutates in place; GET verifies single record, no duplicate/new row. (c) Product delete-vs-archive: DELETE unused → 200 archived:false and disappears from GET /api/products; DELETE a product used by seeded jobs CY/212.01/CY/219.03 → 200 archived:true, product status='archived', excluded from default GET, still visible with include_archived=true, and seeded job still references product_id (history preserved). (d) Masters: create + edit persist location/remarks/status; DELETE an unused master → hard delete (archived:false); DELETE seeded master YOG-27 (used by seeded jobs) → 200 archived:true, validity_status='retired' (soft), still present in GET /api/masters, historical jobs still reference master_id 'YOG-27' — restored to 'active' after test for demo integrity. (e) Audit trail: create→update→delete on a product produced audit_logs entries with action=create/update/delete each having user + timestamp. (f) Regression: GET /api/jobs/{id}/validation for CY/212.01 & CY/219.03 still return 0 FAIL rows. Frontend Playwright UI walk verified with admin login on the public preview URL: (1) Opening the Product create dialog on Customers page and clicking Cancel produced ZERO POST /api/products calls (verified via page.on('request') sniffer) — confirms no empty product is created just by opening the form. (2) Filling name+serial=TC-001+tag=TAG-001+refno=REF-9 and clicking Save creates a product via one POST. (3) Clicking edit-product-{id} re-opens same dialog with prefilled fields; changing name and clicking save-product-btn updates in place. (4) Navigating to /jobs/new, selecting the customer, then selecting the product from the job-product select — job-serial input auto-populates to 'TC-001' and job-certno to 'REF-9' (Tag also propagates via chooseProduct). (5) Delete-product on the unused test product removes it from the UI list. window.confirm dialog is auto-accepted via page.on('dialog'). All data-testids listed in the review request are present and functional. Overall: master/product bug-fix scope is complete and safe (no seeded demo data destroyed).

minor.issue: The DB contains an existing product with empty name (visible as a blank tile on Customers page for the first IASYS customer, plus a duplicate 'IASYS Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd.' customer entry). Likely a legacy row from an earlier iteration BEFORE the name-required validation existed. Not blocking, but recommend a one-time cleanup: db.products.deleteMany({name: ''}) and dedupe duplicate customers.

No admin endpoint to un-archive a product once it has been soft-archived. Test suite must re-PUT with a fresh customer_id/name; there is no dedicated 'restore/reactivate' route. Consider adding PATCH /api/products/{id}/restore.

PUT accepts and persists status='archived' if the client sends it (ProductIn does not restrict it), but the create endpoint hardcodes status='active'. Consider stripping/ignoring status on PUT to avoid clients bypassing the archive workflow.
Only supports filtering by entity_id; no filter by entity_type or action. Not blocking but limits UI drill-downs (e.g., show only 'archive' events across products).

issues: A product tile with an empty name renders as a nearly blank card (just icon + 'S/N — · Tag —'). Add a fallback display like '(unnamed product)' + hide the row if name is blank.

action_items: Clean up legacy empty-named product(s) and duplicate customer rows in the seeded DB.
(Optional) Add PATCH /api/products/{id}/restore and PATCH /api/masters/{id}/restore endpoints so that a soft-archived/retired record can be re-activated by admin.
(Optional) Extend GET /api/audit to accept entity_type and action query params for UI drilldowns.
(Optional) Hide products whose name is empty on Customers page, or add fallback text.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_product/update_master pass body.model_dump() straight into $set — this lets a client PUT status='archived' or status='retired' from the edit form, bypassing the archive workflow. Consider filtering out status on PUT.

delete_product / delete_master responses use archived:true for BOTH product-archive and master-retire; the master case should ideally use a 'retired:true' key or a discriminator to help the frontend show correct toast/label. Currently the toast message text carries the semantics — fine for MVP.

Customers.jsx load() issues N sequential GET /api/products?customer_id=… requests (one per customer) — will be slow with many customers. Consider a single GET /api/products?customer_id__in=… or backend nested payload.
NewJob.jsx chooseProduct only prefills serial_number/tag_number/cert_no; product 'description' and 'range' could also be surfaced (not on prefill list, but useful in the UI as read-only hints).

No frontend guard prevents creating a Job against an archived product (list_products excludes archived so it's hidden in the dropdown, but if the URL is deeplinked with a stale product_id, backend will still create the job). Consider validating product.status != 'archived' in create_job.
